title: ReportNotes
description: Shape of packages/spec/report-notes.json: the standing notes a run's report prints when its setup calls for them (PLAN M4.5, M7.5; ADR-062). Each note is plain text, written once here and read by the web app and, from M7, the report job. Numbers only: no note may state a verdict (CLAUDE.md).

version.description: Bumped whenever a note's text changes, so a report can say which wording it printed.

notes.description: Every note, in the order a report prints them.

ReportNoteCondition.description: When a run's report carries the note. tiedBonds: the run's frozen setup ties at least one bond (a bond the user has not removed, ADR-059, ADR-060).

title.description: Heading of the note in the report.

source.description: Where the note's figures come from, for people; not printed.
